description: A story with every rule left unsaid. The skeptic asks the questions a developer would guess at, from all three lenses, and writes a decision for each.

input.title: Apply a discount code at checkout
input.body: As a shopper, I want to apply a discount code at checkout, so that I pay less when I have one. On the checkout information step there is a Discount code field with an Apply button. A valid code shows a discount line on the overview and lowers the total. An invalid code shows a message and changes nothing.
